chapterTitle: Chapter 5: Action Words (Verbs) - Let's Get Moving! 🏃‍♂️💨
learningGoals: To understand that action words describe things we do. 🤸‍♀️
To identify common doing words in everyday sentences. 🗣️
To connect physical movements with their matching action words. 🏃‍♂️
To use simple verbs correctly while talking about daily routines. 📅
teachingTips: Play 'Simon Says' using only action words to make learning physical and fun. 🗣️
Point out actions while reading bedtime stories, asking 'What is the character doing?' 📚
Narrate your child's actions during playtime like a sports commentator to reinforce verbs. 🎤
Use daily chores as a learning moment by emphasizing words like wash, sweep, and clean. 🧹

funActivities.title: Action Word Charades 🎭
funActivities.description: Take turns acting out simple verbs without speaking while the other person guesses the action word! 🤔

funActivities.title: The Freeze Dance 💃
funActivities.description: Play music and shout out an action word like dance, hop, or wiggle. When the music stops, everyone must freeze! 🛑

funActivities.title: Action Scavenger Hunt 🔍
funActivities.description: Ask your child to find objects in the house where they can do an action, like finding a chair to sit on or a book to read. 🏠
